description: Drinking water fountains and tap points managed by the City of Brussels is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Fontaines et bornes d'eau potable gérées par la Ville de Bruxelles Les fontaines et bornes d'eau potable sont opérationnelles d'avril à septembre inclus. Plus d'info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Public space. Its keywords are Water, Fountain, free, station, street art, freshness. The portal shows 48 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
